emergence.summary: A very rare autosomal-recessive cause of severe early-onset obesity. Leptin (LEP) is the adipocyte-secreted satiety hormone that signals the body's energy/fat state to the hypothalamus, where it ACCELERATES the satiety and energy-expenditure programme (via LEPR -> POMC -> alpha-MSH -> MC4R). Biallelic LEP loss-of-function (homozygous frameshift/missense or bioinactive-leptin alleles) removes that drive -> hypothalamic satiety signalling is UNDER-driven -> the emergent hormone axis falls, producing intense hyperphagia and severe early-onset obesity (with hypogonadotropic hypogonadism and immune/metabolic disturbance). Because the axis is driven DOWN, the corrective direction is UP, and the switch the kit re-derives is to REPLACE the missing hormone: recombinant human leptin (metreleptin) restores the satiety signal and reverses the hyperphagia, adiposity and neuroendocrine abnormalities -- the seminal demonstration (Farooqi 1999) that exogenous leptin dramatically reduced food intake in a leptin-deficient child is the direct confirmation of the deficiency-axis read. This is the EXACT CONTRAST PARTNER to X-linked hypophosphataemia in the kit: XLH is a HORMONE axis driven UP (FGF23 over-produced) corrected by RESTRAINING the excess hormone (burosumab), whereas congenital leptin deficiency is a HORMONE axis driven DOWN corrected by REPLACING the deficient hormone (metreleptin) -- the same hormone-axis logic read on opposite signs. The downstream MC4R-pathway agonist setmelanotide is the established therapy for the RECEPTOR-deficient sibling genotypes (LEPR deficiency, and POMC / PCSK1 deficiency), where the ligand is present but its signal is not transduced; it is NOT the lever for LEP-LIGAND deficiency itself (where replacing leptin restores the upstream signal) -- named as a distinct boundary, not folded in. The gamma read is of the LEP promoter switch STRUCTURE; the disease lesions are coding (e.g. p.Arg105Trp; the original homozygous frameshift), outside the promoter firewall. Magnitude [O].

per_gene.note: LEP encodes leptin, the adipocyte-derived type-I-cytokine satiety hormone that signals energy/fat sufficiency to the hypothalamus and ACCELERATES the satiety / energy-expenditure programme (LEPR on POMC neurons -> alpha-MSH -> MC4R). Biallelic LOF (null / frameshift, or a bioinactive-leptin allele) removes the drive -> hypothalamic satiety signalling is under-driven -> the hormone axis falls (axis DOWN), giving hyperphagia and severe early-onset obesity. Located 7q32.1 (OMIM 164160). NCBI official symbol LEP. Autosomal recessive. Coding lesions (the original homozygous frameshift; p.Arg105Trp; bioinactive p.Asn103Lys); promoter firewall respected.
per_gene.src: Montague 1997 Nature 387:903 (congenital leptin deficiency, homozygous LEP frameshift -> severe early-onset obesity); Wabitsch 2015 NEJM 372:48 (bioinactive leptin)

emergence.firewall: gamma reads promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only; perturbation DIRECTION is forced+cited; MAGNITUDE is [O] (runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable).

levers.push_direction: supply recombinant leptin -> restore the hypothalamic satiety signal -> raise the under-driven leptin hormone axis back toward normal (axis UP), reducing hyperphagia and adiposity. The switch-level corrective: it replaces the deficient hormone itself.
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] degree of appetite / adiposity normalisation not derived from sequence
levers.src: Farooqi 1999 NEJM 341:879 (recombinant leptin reduces food intake in congenital leptin deficiency); metreleptin (Myalept/Myalepta) FDA 2014 / EMA 2018 (approved leptin-replacement biologic; established treatment for congenital leptin deficiency)

levers.push_direction: restore endogenous leptin expression at the locus -> restore the satiety signal (axis UP); investigational gene-level alternative to recombinant-protein replacement
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] restored-leptin level not derived from sequence; investigational
levers.src: leptin-replacement principle (Farooqi 1999) extended to a gene-level restore; no approved LEP gene therapy

falsifiers.claim: leptin (LEP) loss lowers hypothalamic satiety-signal tone (axis DOWN), producing hyperphagia
falsifiers.falsifier: an LEP loss-of-function genotype that REDUCED food intake / adiposity, or leptin replacement that INCREASED hyperphagia, refutes the deficiency (axis-DOWN) direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: ad-libitum energy intake / satiety response and fat mass versus serum leptin, stratified by LEP genotype (the Farooqi 1999 design)

falsifiers.claim: replacing leptin is the CORRECTIVE direction in LEP-ligand deficiency
falsifiers.falsifier: if recombinant leptin failed to reduce hyperphagia / adiposity in genetically confirmed congenital leptin deficiency, the replace-LEP lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: change in energy intake and fat mass on recombinant-leptin replacement in congenital leptin deficiency
